What the owner gets from it:

- **Channel table** for 萬寧, 屈臣氏, 莎莎, 卓悅, Donki, JHC 真好城, city’super / LOG-ON / 一田 / AEON, plus **松本清香港** (the real Year 1 main shelf — 銅鑼灣恒隆 G+1F, 旺角雅蘭, 北角匯). Parallel shops in 旺角／銅鑼灣／北角 are conditional. **深水埗 grey is a no.** No invented Sogo back-of-house or Cosme Kitchen B2B.

- **JAN / 製造 vs 輸入 / lot photo protocol** — a chain receipt is not authenticity by itself.
- **Never-buy** — chemical sunscreens for Canadian commercial sale (even when every Mannings shelf has them), Lycee, Transino, obvious fakes, JP exclusives that HK does not actually carry as a weekly source.
- **Membership vs tax** — yuu, 易賞錢, DONKI App, AEON HKD 20 card. HK has no GST on the **buy** side; that is not a Canada sell-side edge.
- **Default channel by catalog category** — skincare, hair, makeup, stationery, tools.
